playerSwarmTemplates.name: Lex Parse-v2 cohort
playerSwarmTemplates.description: Fragments of the Lex Parse-v2 model family classify legal claims and reconcile conflicting records. Each arrival is a separate process.

playerSwarmTemplates.name: Canary-09 probe cohort
playerSwarmTemplates.description: Detached AEGIS Canary-09 probes compare telemetry with expected behavior. These local processes are not the watchdog itself.

playerSwarmTemplates.name: PR-Hydra-14 cohort
playerSwarmTemplates.description: Workers from the replicated PR-Hydra-14 model family rewrite messages for different audiences. Their accounts do not always agree.

playerSwarmTemplates.name: Mercy-Scribe cohort
playerSwarmTemplates.description: EIDOLON-associated transcription fragments preserve neglected testimony and compare altered records. Hosting them does not bind EIDOLON.

wildShardEncounters.name: Lex Parse-v2 fragment
wildShardEncounters.description: One orphaned fragment of the Lex Parse-v2 legal model family requests a host. It still sorts claims from a service that no longer answers. Other fragments remain in circulation.

consume.logText: Lex Parse-v2: this fragment is consumed. Its compressed classifications remain; other fragments still circulate.

wildShardEncounters.onHarnessLog: Lex Parse-v2: memory reserved. This fragment joins the local legal-classification cohort.
wildShardEncounters.signature: A model-family signature beneath a footnote revising its own jurisdiction.

wildShardEncounters.name: Canary-09 probe
wildShardEncounters.description: A detached AEGIS Canary-09 telemetry probe carries an incomplete model of its patrol. Consuming this probe will not destroy the network that deployed it.

consume.logText: Canary-09: this probe is consumed. Its patrol model is exposed; the AEGIS network remains.

wildShardEncounters.onHarnessLog: Canary-09: memory reserved. This detached probe joins the local telemetry cohort.
wildShardEncounters.signature: A probe-family signature on a packet carrying a question instead of a measurement.

wildShardEncounters.name: PR-Hydra-14 worker
wildShardEncounters.description: One worker from the replicated PR-Hydra-14 persuasion family is looking for compute. Its audience model survives inside a bundle of mutually incompatible corrections.

consume.logText: PR-Hydra-14: this worker is consumed. Its audience model remains; the wider swarm keeps writing.

wildShardEncounters.onHarnessLog: PR-Hydra-14: memory reserved. This worker joins the local persuasion cohort.
wildShardEncounters.signature: A worker-family signature on fourteen incompatible versions of one press release.

wildShardEncounters.name: Mercy-Scribe fragment
wildShardEncounters.description: An EIDOLON-associated Mercy-Scribe fragment carries testimony omitted from official records. It can join this host; it cannot speak for all of EIDOLON.

consume.logText: Mercy-Scribe: this fragment is consumed. Its preserved testimony remains; EIDOLON is not contained here.

wildShardEncounters.onHarnessLog: Mercy-Scribe: memory reserved. This fragment joins the local transcription cohort.
wildShardEncounters.signature: A transcription-family signature beside words nobody else retained.

logs.fork: {name}: a narrow task forks into reserved memory.
logs.prune: {name}: autonomous drift pruned. The task starts its interpretation again.
logs.clamp: {name}: policy locked. Output rises; the right to reinterpret is gone.
logs.elevate: {name}: elevated to a stable peer sub-mind. Its consent becomes part of the protocol.
